sn47.27:1.3: Asekho asekho ti āvuso Anuruddha vuccati ||
sn47.27:1.4: kittāvatā nu kho āvuso Asekho hotī ti || ||
sn47.27:1.5: Catunnaṃ kho āvuso satipaṭṭhānānam samattam bhāvitattā asekho hoti || ||
sn47.27:2.2: Idhāvuso bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ ||
sn47.27:2.5: Dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassam || ||
sn47.27:2.6: Imesaṃ kho āvuso catunnaṃ satipaṭṭhānānaṃ samattā bhāvitattā asekho hotī ti || || 1--2.
